segments.title: Station Sign-On & Cold Open
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the broadcast sign-on; devil substitutes for Pepito while he explores toilets.

segments.title: Epstein Emails & Gabe Newell Yacht
segments.notes: Case covers the Epstein email release referencing Trump and Bill Clinton, then discusses Valve co-founder Gabe Newell's $500M superyacht Leviathan.

segments.title: AI Maya Chat & Jimmy Wales Walkout
segments.notes: Case and Chet test the AI companion Maya with a two-minute prompt, then watch a clip of Jimmy Wales ending an interview over a founder/co-founder question.

segments.title: Snack Reformulations, Labubu Film, Epstein Highlights & MrBeast Park
segments.notes: Doritos and Cheetos remove artificial colors; Sony acquires Labubu film rights; Kim Kardashian's psychic bar exam predictions; deeper Epstein email highlights including Michael Wolff's strategy notes; China bridge collapse; Fedora Man unmasked; MrBeast opens Beast World in Riyadh.

segments.title: Mark Beatty Medical Story & Bill Clinton Bit
segments.notes: Case reads about MrBeast's brother Mark Beatty losing genital sensation, then interviews a Bill Clinton impression who admits to oral sex with Trump and discusses carnival life.

segments.title: Dog Shooter vs Owner Debate
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate whether the dog that shot its owner or the owner is better; Munch reveals a sensor bar hiding lactating nipples triggered by victory.

segments.title: Air Walking, Running Man & Glasses Care
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget attempts air walking and a Running Man dance tutorial with his deceased father in a wooden board, then watches a glasses-cleaning guide.

segments.title: Presidential Impressions & K-Pop Lyric Review
segments.notes: Case cycles through Bill Clinton and Abraham Lincoln impressions while watching viral videos, culminating in a K-pop worst-lyrics montage reviewed by Kendall.

segments.title: Yacht Rock Songwriting Session
segments.notes: DJ C4 composes a yacht rock track with chat-sourced lyrics, recruits a tiny wizard to perform vocals, and closes the broadcast.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors the Friday news desk, hosts Amongst the Web, and interviews a Bill Clinton impression using a personal compromising-material Rolodex.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers the cold-open sign-on, substitutes a devil for himself during a toilet break, and admits to devil worship.

characters.name: Chet
characters.notes: science correspondent. Co-hosts Amongst the Web, reacts to AI Maya and Jimmy Wales clip, and participates in news desk banter.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argues for the dog shooter in the Munch & Crum debate and claims victory-induced lactation requiring a sensor bar.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Defends the shot owner in the debate and reveals he was a mayor in the early 2000s who courted Epstein-adjacent billionaires.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: instructional host. Leads How To with Jeb, attempting air walking and Running Man dances while bickering with his father's spirit in a wooden board.

characters.name: DJ C4
characters.notes: music producer. Writes a yacht rock song with chat lyrics and a tiny wizard vocalist to close the show.

lore_notes.fact: Pepito admits to explicitly worshiping the devil during a devil-substitution producing stint.
Case Blackwell maintains a personal Rolodex of compromising material on public figures to summon them instantly.
Crum served as a mayor in the early 2000s and courted billionaire investors including Epstein-adjacent figures.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covers the Epstein email dump, Gabe Newell's superyacht, and a cascade of viral clips before Munch and Crum debate a dog-shooting incident. Jeb Nogget leads a chaotic Running Man tutorial, and DJ C4 closes the broadcast with a chat-written yacht rock track performed by a tiny wizard.
